correctness.rationale: The published classification and composition lemma reduce the problem to a finite multiplication table. All entries are formal except the products of the maximal-cluster translation by itself and after adjoining the identity. Those two identities are proved on arbitrary finite reflexive-transitive frames using the published maximal-world relation, then transferred to S4 and Grz by finite completeness. Exhaustive small-frame evaluation independently reproduces all twenty-five entries for both logics.

value.rationale: Composition is intrinsic to interpretation theory. The result upgrades two five-element classifications into a complete algebra of iteration and interaction, shows that S4 and Grz share the same abstract translation monoid, and rules out nontrivial iteration dynamics in the entire parameter-free normal fragment.
